Alex (Support): Escalation: Sundial Finance onboarding blocked. Two failures surfaced during customer data load: OIDC auth fails (401) and embeddings mismatch causing empty search returns. Renewal ~40 days. Can CS pick up high priority? INC-5302
Priya (CSM): Acknowledge. Is this only in sandbox? Need short impact note for the account health doc.
Alex (Support): Sandbox only but config parity with prod. Logs: `oauth: invalid_token_audience, status=401` and embed pipeline: `dimension_mismatch expected=1024 got=768`. They used older client for embeddings.
Rashid (CS Ops): Splitting owners: auth/team infra for OIDC, CS Ops for re-ingest. I can craft a conversion + reindex job and estimate window.
Priya (CSM): @Leah can eng run a tenant-scoped JWKS refresh or provide a rollback plan? We need a stopgap before the customer loses confidence.
Leah (Eng): Quick triage: IdP rotated signing keys; our JWKS cache hadn't refreshed. Mitigation: force re-fetch for tenant or lower JWKS TTL. I'll run a refresh and add an endpoint for on-demand refresh. ETA for hotfix ~2-4h.
Alex (Support): Ticket INC-5302 updated with sanitized logs and sample payloads. ticket-bot: status set to "escalated to CS + eng".
Priya (CSM): Draft customer-facing note for Sundial: "Hi team 90 we're investigating auth token validation and an ingest schema mismatch. Immediate: force JWKS refresh for your tenant and provide a conversion script to reindex embeddings. Auth mitigation expected within 4h; reindex plan within 24h. Request 30m sync in next 60m." Thoughts?
Connor (Renewals): Flag renewal tracker: risk -> Elevated until reindex completes. Please include a brief summary for buyer success.
Rashid (CS Ops): Quick workaround for embeddings: run our re-embed tool with `--schema-migrate v0.9->v1 --batch 400`. Backfill estimate: 5-7 hours depending on dataset. I'll prepare a one-click job and run during off-hours if they prefer.
Leah (Eng): Ops command to force refresh: `POST https://api.redwood/internal/tenants/sundialfinance/actions/refresh_jwks` with ops token. I'll run now and monitor.
Priya (CSM): Comms plan bullets for internal handoff:
- Immediate: Force JWKS refresh (Eng) 9 owner: Leah 9 ETA: now-1h
- Short-term: Patch JWKS cache behavior (Eng infra) 9 owner: Eng 9 ETA: 2-4h
- Reindex: Run migration + re-embed job (CS Ops) 9 owner: Rashid 9 ETA: 5-7h (can be overnight)
- Customer sync: 30m within 1h 9 owner: Priya
Priya (CSM): I'll send the note and book the 30m sync for 10:30am ET. @Alex attach the sanitized logs and @Rashid add the runbook link.
Alex (Support): Logs attached. ticket-bot: Comment added to INC-5302 by Alex: "Escalated CS + Eng. Suspect JWKS cache + embed client schema mismatch. Artifacts attached."
Connor (Renewals): Added account health note: Sundial Finance 9 renewal status = Monitoring (escalation).
Leah (Eng): Running tenant refresh now, will report in ~8m. :rocket:
Rashid (CS Ops): Building migration script and runbook, sharing link once uploaded.
Priya (CSM): Thanks team. I'll own customer comms and weekly status until fully resolved. Ping me for any regression.
